sources.excerpt: In basketball, the United States women's team defeats France 97–79 in the final to win the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup in Berlin, Germany, further extending their lead of 12 total wins.
The tournament was hosted in Berlin, Germany, from 4 to 13 September 2026.
The 83rd annual Venice International Film Festival took place from 2 to 12 September 2026, at Venice Lido in Italy.
The Golden Lion was awarded to Woman Unknown by May el-Toukhy.
The Olympic flame arrives in Dakar, Senegal, ahead of the upcoming Youth Olympic Games, which will be the first Olympic Games held in Africa.

After analyzing four fossils uncovered in Wyoming and the Yukon Territory in Canada, a team of researchers suggests that the wild cat was more closely related to the modern puma, also called the mountain lion or cougar, than to today’s cheetahs.
The researchers also wanted to know what an animal with such a wide range ate, so they analyzed forms of nitrogen and carbon in all four fossils.

The work hinted that the creature from Wyoming, which lived around 23,000 years ago, probably feasted on herbivores like pronghorn. On the other hand, the Yukon cats, which lived around 31,000 years ago, likely munched on fish such as salmon.
